implementation_rules: Run backfills in one-year buckets and store the exact query, source ID, run timestamp, count, and errors.
Union and deduplicate by PMID; retain all journal and discovery query IDs that matched each PMID.
Do not use hasabstract, English-language, humans, or publication-type exclusions during ingestion.
Use deterministic rules and AI only after retrieval; never permanently delete an AI-excluded citation.
For incremental synchronization, query new records by Create Date [crdt] and revised records by Modification Date [lr] using an explicit overlapping date window.
Use PMID as the canonical PubMed identifier and DOI as a secondary cross-source identifier.
Seed labels from discovery queries are provenance hints, not final topic classifications.
